examples.chinese: 我要買這本書，不要買那本書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi zhè běn shū, bú yào mǎi nà běn shū.
examples.english: I want to buy this book, not that one.

examples.chinese: 那個學生很好看。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge xuéshēng hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: The student is very good-looking.

examples.chinese: 我要買這本書，不要買那本書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi zhè běn shū, bú yào mǎi nà běn shū.
examples.english: I want to buy this book, not that one.

examples.chinese: 這朵花很好看。那個學生很好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duǒ huā hěn hǎokàn. Nàge xuéshēng hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: This flower is very pretty. That student is very good-looking.

examples.chinese: 這些是中文書，那些是英文書。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shì Zhōngwén shū, nàxiē shì Yīngwén shū.
examples.english: These are books in Chinese; those are in English.

examples.chinese: 這些是中文書，那些是英文書。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shì Zhōngwén shū, nàxiē shì Yīngwén shū.
examples.english: These are books in Chinese; those are in English.

examples.chinese: 那家飲料店的飲料很好喝，我們去那裡買。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā yǐnliào diàn de yǐnliào hěn hǎohē, wǒmen qù nàlǐ mǎi.
examples.english: That beverage store serves great beverages. Let’s go there and get some.

examples.chinese: 你的筆在那本書上面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de bǐ zài nà běn shū shàngmiàn.
examples.english: Your pen is on top of the book.

examples.chinese: 你的錢包在那件衣服下面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de qiánbāo zài nà jiàn yīfu xiàmiàn.
examples.english: Your wallet is under that piece of clothing.

examples.chinese: 那家咖啡廳怎麼樣？你想再去嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā kāfēitīng zěnmeyàng? Nǐ xiǎng zài qù ma?
examples.english: What do you think about that café? Would you like to go again?

examples.chinese: 那個孩子很愛踢足球。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge háizi hěn ài tī zúqiú.
examples.english: That kid loves to play soccer very much.

examples.chinese: 那家店的冰淇淋很好吃，可是有點兒貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de bīngqílín hěn hǎochī, kěshì yǒudiǎnr guì.
examples.english: That store has delicious ice cream, but it is a bit expensive.

examples.chinese: 那個孩子很喜歡畫畫，他畫得很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge háizi hěn xǐhuān huàhuà, tā huà de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: That child likes painting and he draws very well.

examples.chinese: 我的朋友在那家旅館前面等我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyǒu zài nà jiā lǚguǎn qiánmiàn děng wǒ.
examples.english: My friend is waiting for me in front of that hotel.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳很近，我們走路去吧！
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng hěn jìn, wǒmen zǒulù qù ba!
examples.english: That restaurant is very close; let's walk there!

examples.chinese: 那位司機開車開得很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi sījī kāichē kāi de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: That driver drives very well.

examples.chinese: 那個牌子的褲子都不便宜。
examples.pinyin: Nàge páizi de kùzi dōu bù piányi.
examples.english: The pants of that brand are all not cheap.

examples.chinese: 那家咖啡廳在郵局對面。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā kāfēitīng zài yóujú duìmiàn.
examples.english: That coffee shop is across from the post office.

examples.chinese: 那條裙子很漂亮，可是非常貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà tiáo qúnzi hěn piàoliang, kěshì fēicháng guì.
examples.english: That skirt is very pretty, but it is very expensive.

examples.chinese: 你不想坐公車，那(麼)我們坐計程車吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù xiǎng zuò gōngchē, nà(me) wǒmen zuò jìchéngchē ba.
examples.english: You don't want to take the bus; then let's take a taxi.

examples.chinese: 他不在教室裡上課，那他在哪裡？
examples.pinyin: Tā bù zài jiàoshì lǐ shàngkè, nà tā zài nǎlǐ?
examples.english: He is not in the classroom having class, so where is he?

examples.chinese: 這張椅子不太乾淨，我要那張。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng yǐzi bù tài gānjìng, wǒ yào nà zhāng.
examples.english: This chair is not very clean; I want that one.

examples.chinese: 我常常在電視上看到那位有名的醫生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng zài diànshì shàng kàndào nà wèi yǒumíng de yīshēng.
examples.english: I often see that famous doctor on TV.

examples.chinese: 那家有名的麵包店賣很多種麵包，都很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā yǒumíng de miànbāo diàn mài hěn duō zhǒng miànbāo, dōu hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: That famous bakery sells many kinds of bread; all are delicious.

examples.chinese: 你先往左轉，再往右轉，就到那家餐廳了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān wǎng zuǒ zhuǎn, zài wǎng yòu zhuǎn, jiù dào nà jiā cāntīng le.
examples.english: First turn left, then turn right, and you'll arrive at that restaurant.

examples.chinese: 我出了捷運站，就看到那家銀行了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chū le jiéyùn zhàn, jiù kàndào nà jiā yínháng le.
examples.english: As soon as I exited the MRT station, I saw that bank.

examples.chinese: 那件衣服有一點兒舊，可是還可以穿很久。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiàn yīfu yǒu yīdiǎnr jiù, kěshì hái kěyǐ chuān hěn jiǔ.
examples.english: That piece of clothing is a little old, but can still be worn for a long time.

examples.chinese: 他住的那棟大樓附近有學校，也有餐廳。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhù de nà dòng dàlóu fùjìn yǒu xuéxiào, yě yǒu cāntīng.
examples.english: Near the building where he lives there is a school, and also a restaurant.

examples.chinese: 我不知道那個地方怎麼去，所以應該先查查地圖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào nàge dìfāng zěnme qù, suǒyǐ yīnggāi xiān chácha dìtú.
examples.english: I don't know how to get to that place, so I should first check the map.

examples.chinese: 公園的音樂晚會快要開始了，可不可以請你們幫我排那些椅子？
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán de yīnyuè wǎnhuì kuài yào kāishǐ le, kě bù kěyǐ qǐng nǐmen bāng wǒ pái nàxiē yǐzi?
examples.english: The park's music evening party is about to start; could you please help me line up those chairs?

examples.chinese: 我同事說那家店的麵包很好吃，大人、小孩都喜歡，很受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngshì shuō nà jiā diàn de miànbāo hěn hǎochī, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xǐhuān, hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: My colleague says that bakery's bread is very delicious; both adults and children like it—it's very popular.

examples.chinese: 那家新的百貨公司離這裡遠嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā xīn de bǎihuò gōngsī lí zhèlǐ yuǎn ma?
examples.english: Is that new department store far from here?

examples.chinese: 那個明星演戲前都會先研究戲裡的人物、故事，最後才決定表演的方式。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng yǎnxì qián dōu huì xiān yánjiū xì lǐ de rénwù, gùshì, zuìhòu cái juédìng biǎoyǎn de fāngshì.
examples.english: Before that star acts in a drama, he always first studies the characters and story in the play, and only then decides on the way to perform.

examples.chinese: 那個明星很會演戲，演了幾年戲就開始當導演，沒想到第一部戲就成功了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng hěn huì yǎnxì, yǎn le jǐ nián xì jiù kāishǐ dāng dǎoyǎn, méi xiǎngdào dì yī bù xì jiù chénggōng le.
examples.english: That star is very good at acting; after acting for a few years, he started being a director. Unexpectedly, his first film was a success.

examples.chinese: 那個演員非常喜歡演戲，不管導演給他多麼難演的角色，他都願意試試看。
examples.pinyin: Nàge yǎnyuán fēicháng xǐhuan yǎnxì, bùguǎn dǎoyǎn gěi tā duōme nán yǎn de juésè, tā dōu yuànyì shìshi kàn.
examples.english: That actor really loves acting; no matter how difficult a role the director gives him, he is willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: 李導演因為拍那部電影而跟銀行借了不少錢。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ dǎoyǎn yīnwèi pāi nà bù diànyǐng ér gēn yínháng jièle bùshǎo qián.
examples.english: Director Li, because he was filming that movie, borrowed quite a lot of money from the bank.

examples.chinese: 沒想到我奶奶那個年代流行的衣服，現在又流行起來了。李小龍（Bruce Lee）是七○年 （qīlíng niándài，1970∼1979） 非常有名的功夫明星。
examples.pinyin: Méi xiǎngdào wǒ nǎinai nàge niándài liúxíng de yīfu, xiànzài yòu liúxíng qǐlái le. Lǐ Xiǎolóng (Bruce Lee) shì qīlíng niándài fēicháng yǒumíng de gōngfu míngxīng.
examples.english: I never thought that the clothes that were popular in my grandmother's era would become popular again now. Bruce Lee was a very famous martial arts star in the 1970s.

examples.chinese: 小王手裡提著那麼多東西，好像很重，我們過去幫他提一些吧！
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng shǒu lǐ tízhe nàme duō dōngxi, hǎoxiàng hěn zhòng, wǒmen guòqù bāng tā tí yīxiē ba!
examples.english: Xiao Wang is carrying so many things in his hands; they look heavy. Let's go over and help him carry some!

examples.chinese: 小黃要去便利商店領錢， 我請他幫我買杯咖啡。老闆去歐洲旅遊回來，買了荷蘭傳統的點心送給大家，叫我們去助理那裡領。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Huáng yào qù biànlì shāngdiàn lǐng qián, wǒ qǐng tā bāng wǒ mǎi bēi kāfēi. Lǎobǎn qù Ōuzhōu lǚyóu huílái, mǎile Hélán chuántǒng de diǎnxin sòng gěi dàjiā, jiào wǒmen qù zhùlǐ nàlǐ lǐng.
examples.english: Xiao Huang is going to the convenience store to withdraw money; I asked him to buy me a cup of coffee. The boss came back from a trip to Europe and bought traditional Dutch snacks to give to everyone, and told us to pick them up from the assistant.

examples.chinese: 那家廣告公司提供了五個工作機會，只要是設計系畢業的都可以去試試看。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā guǎnggào gōngsī tígōng le wǔ ge gōngzuò jīhuì, zhǐyào shì shèjì xì bìyè de dōu kěyǐ qù shìshi kàn.
examples.english: That advertising company provided five job opportunities; anyone who has graduated from a design department can go and give it a try.

examples.chinese: 那家超市的生意非常好，因為他們進了很多特別的零食，大人、小孩都想嘗嘗看。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā chāoshì de shēngyì fēicháng hǎo, yīnwèi tāmen jìn le hěn duō tèbié de língshí, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xiǎng chángchang kàn.
examples.english: That supermarket's business is very good because they have stocked many special snacks; both adults and children want to taste them.

examples.chinese: 那個人看起來很神祕，大家都不知道他從哪裡來、做什麼工作。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge rén kàn qǐlái hěn shénmì, dàjiā dōu bù zhīdào tā cóng nǎlǐ lái, zuò shénme gōngzuò.
examples.english: That person looks very mysterious; everyone doesn't know where he comes from or what job he does.

examples.chinese: 那位服務生不笑的時候，樣子看起來很兇，其實他對客人的態度很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi fúwùshēng bù xiào de shíhou, yàngzi kàn qǐlái hěn xiōng, qíshí tā duì kèrén de tàidù hěn hǎo.
examples.english: When that waiter doesn't smile, he looks very fierce, but actually his attitude toward customers is very good.

examples.chinese: 小元昨天剛買了一件八千元的大衣，沒想到那家服裝店今天打三折，他太吃虧了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoyuán zuótiān gāng mǎi le yī jiàn bāqiān yuán de dàyī, méi xiǎngdào nà jiā fúzhuāngdiàn jīntiān dǎ sān zhé, tā tài chīkuī le.
examples.english: Xiaoyuan just bought an 8,000-yuan coat yesterday; unexpectedly, that clothing store is having a 70% off sale today—he really suffered a loss.

examples.chinese: 像踢足球那樣的運動，對年紀大的人不太合適。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng tī zúqiú nàyàng de yùndòng, duì niánjì dà de rén bù tài héshì.
examples.english: Sports like playing soccer are not very suitable for older people.

examples.chinese: 小文為了得到超商送的小禮物，每天都特地去那裡買咖啡、三明治。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎowén wèile dédào chāoshāng sòng de xiǎo lǐwù, měitiān dōu tèdì qù nàlǐ mǎi kāfēi, sānmíngzhì.
examples.english: In order to get the small gift from the convenience store, Xiaowen specially goes there every day to buy coffee and sandwiches.

examples.chinese: 那位大明星身上穿的、手上戴的 ，都是有名的牌子。經理做事態度認真、負責，我從他身上學到了很多做人做事的道理。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi dà míngxīng shēnshang chuān de, shǒushang dài de, dōu shì yǒumíng de páizi. Jīnglǐ zuòshì tàidù rènzhēn, fùzé, wǒ cóng tā shēnshang xué dào le hěn duō zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ.
examples.english: What that big star wears on her body and on her hands are all famous brands. The manager's work attitude is serious and responsible; I have learned many principles of how to conduct myself and do things from him.

examples.chinese: 這家專櫃的店員比剛才那家的還要兇，難怪生意這麼差。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā zhuānguì de diànyuán bǐ gāngcái nà jiā de hái yào xiōng, nánguài shēngyì zhème chà.
examples.english: The clerk at this brand counter is even fiercer than the one at the previous store; no wonder business is so bad.

examples.chinese: 小龍受不了在那個又熱又髒的工廠工作，只做了三天就離開了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎolóng shòubuliǎo zài nàge yòu rè yòu zāng de gōngchǎng gōngzuò, zhǐ zuò le sān tiān jiù líkāi le.
examples.english: Xiaolong could not bear to work in that hot and dirty factory; he only worked for three days and then left.

examples.chinese: 醫生說那個病人得住院，要是三天以內都沒發燒、頭也不痛了，就可以出院了。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō nàge bìngrén děi zhùyuàn, yàoshi sān tiān yǐnèi dōu méi fāshāo, tóu yě bú tòng le, jiù kěyǐ chūyuàn le.
examples.english: The doctor said that patient has to be hospitalized; if within three days he has no fever and his head no longer hurts, then he can be discharged.

examples.chinese: 那三家商店都賣相同牌子的皮包，我們最好先比個價，再決定買哪一家的。
examples.pinyin: Nà sān jiā shāngdiàn dōu mài xiāngtóng páizi de píbāo, wǒmen zuìhǎo xiān bǐ ge jià, zài juédìng mǎi nǎ yì jiā de.
examples.english: Those three stores all sell handbags of the same brand; we'd better compare prices first, then decide which one to buy from.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠生產的皮鞋、皮帶，不但品質好，價錢也不貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng shēngchǎn de píxié, pídài, bùdàn pǐnzhí hǎo, jiàqián yě bù guì.
examples.english: The leather shoes and belts that that factory produces are not only good in quality, but also not expensive in price.

examples.chinese: 包小姐的眼光很好，一看就知道那件黃色外套的品質最好。妹妹：我希望將來找個又聰明又有錢 ，而且很體貼我的男朋友。 姊姊：妳的眼光太高了，恐怕找不到。
examples.pinyin: Bāo xiǎojiě de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, yí kàn jiù zhīdào nà jiàn huángsè wàitào de pǐnzhí zuì hǎo. Mèimei: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái zhǎo ge yòu cōngmíng yòu yǒu qián, érqiě hěn tǐtiē wǒ de nánpéngyou. Jiějie: Nǐ de yǎnguāng tài gāo le, kǒngpà zhǎo bú dào.
examples.english: Miss Bao has a good eye; she can tell at a glance that the quality of that yellow coat is the best. Younger sister: I hope to find a boyfriend in the future who is smart, rich, and very considerate of me. Older sister: Your standards are too high; I'm afraid you won't find one.

examples.chinese: 那對雙胞胎姐妹不但長得很像，連性格也一樣開朗、大方。
examples.pinyin: Nà duì shuāngbāotāi jiěmèi bùdàn zhǎng de hěn xiàng, lián xìnggé yě yíyàng kāilǎng, dàfāng.
examples.english: That pair of twin sisters not only look very much alike, but even their personalities are equally cheerful and generous.

examples.chinese: 那所雙語學校強調，除了中文課以外，其他的課程都是用英文上的。
examples.pinyin: Nà suǒ shuāngyǔ xuéxiào qiángdiào, chúle Zhōngwén kè yǐwài, qítā de kèchéng dōu shì yòng Yīngwén shàng de.
examples.english: That bilingual school emphasizes that, except for Chinese classes, all other courses are taught in English.

examples.chinese: 這是我爺爺抱著我的照片，那時候我才一歲呢！
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ yéye bàozhe wǒ de zhàopiàn, nà shíhou wǒ cái yí suì ne!
examples.english: This is a photo of my grandfather holding me; at that time I was only one year old!

examples.chinese: 除夕那天我送給父母一萬塊的紅包，祝福他們新年快樂，大吉大利！
examples.pinyin: Chúxī nà tiān wǒ sòng gěi fùmǔ yí wàn kuài de hóngbāo, zhùfú tāmen xīnnián kuàilè, dàjí dàlì!
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, I gave my parents a red envelope with ten thousand dollars, wishing them a happy New Year and great good fortune!

examples.chinese: 那兩家便利商店同樣提供客人休息的座位，但是第二家的空間比第一家大多了。林媽媽總是給她的雙胞胎女兒穿同樣顏色、同樣大小的衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nà liǎng jiā biànlì shāngdiàn tóngyàng tígōng kèrén xiūxi de zuòwèi, dànshì dì èr jiā de kōngjiān bǐ dì yī jiā dà duō le. Lín māma zǒngshì gěi tā de shuāngbāotāi nǚ'ér chuān tóngyàng yánsè, tóngyàng dàxiǎo de yīfu.
examples.english: Those two convenience stores similarly provide seats for customers to rest, but the second store's space is much larger than the first's. Mrs. Lin always dresses her twin daughters in clothes of the same color and the same size.

examples.chinese: 李先生從不吃泡麵、薯條、熱狗那樣的食物，因為他覺得不健康。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng cóngbù chī pàomiàn, shǔtiáo, règǒu nàyàng de shíwù, yīnwèi tā juéde bù jiànkāng.
examples.english: Mr. Li never eats foods like instant noodles, French fries, or hot dogs, because he thinks they are unhealthy.

examples.chinese: 母親節那天，我親自做了一個大蛋糕，送給最親愛的媽媽。
examples.pinyin: Mǔqīnjié nà tiān, wǒ qīnzì zuò le yī gè dà dàngāo, sòng gěi zuì qīn'ài de māma.
examples.english: On Mother's Day, I personally made a big cake and gave it to my dearest mother.

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都會跟親人聚在一起吃年夜飯、給紅包，互相恭喜新年好。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài chúxī nà tiān, dōu huì gēn qīnrén jù zài yīqǐ chī niányèfàn, gěi hóngbāo, hùxiāng gōngxǐ xīnnián hǎo.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people always gather with their kinsfolk to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, give red envelopes, and wish each other a Happy New Year.

examples.chinese: 那輛汽車突然從路口開了出來， 把我嚇了一跳。聽說經理後天就要離開公司了。 這個消息太突然了，大家一時沒辦法接受。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng qìchē tūrán cóng lùkǒu kāi le chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào. Tīngshuō jīnglǐ hòutiān jiù yào líkāi gōngsī le. Zhège xiāoxi tài tūrán le, dàjiā yīshí méi bànfǎ jiēshòu.
examples.english: That car suddenly drove out from the intersection and startled me. I heard that the manager is leaving the company the day after tomorrow. This news is too sudden; everyone couldn't accept it for a moment.

examples.chinese: 那位老先生走著走著，路旁的樹木突然倒了下來，他差一點就受傷了。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo xiānshēng zǒuzhe zǒuzhe, lù páng de shùmù tūrán dǎo le xiàlái, tā chà yīdiǎn jiù shòushāng le.
examples.english: That elderly gentleman was walking and walking, when suddenly the trees beside the road fell down; he was almost injured.

examples.chinese: 那個地區昨天夜裡突然停水、停電，還好今天中午就恢復正常了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge dìqū zuótiān yèlǐ tūrán tíngshuǐ, tíngdiàn, hái hǎo jīntiān zhōngwǔ jiù huīfù zhèngcháng le.
examples.english: That area suddenly had a water cut and power outage last night, but fortunately it returned to normal by noon today.

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上突然發生強烈地震，學校旁的那座橋塌了，還好沒人受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng tūrán fāshēng qiángliè dìzhèn, xuéxiào páng de nà zuò qiáo tā le, hái hǎo méi rén shòushāng.
examples.english: Last night a strong earthquake suddenly occurred; the bridge beside the school collapsed, but fortunately no one was injured.

examples.chinese: 我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢。那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé jiějie xiǎoshíhòu cháng wèile qiǎng wánjù chǎo gè méiwán, yǒu shíhòu hái dǎjià ne. Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì qǐng dào le dàjiā zuì xǐ'ài de míngxīng, suǒyǐ ménpiào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.
examples.english: When my older sister and I were little, we often argued endlessly over competing for toys, and sometimes we even fought. That concert invited everyone's favorite star, so the tickets were quickly snatched up.

examples.chinese: 那家便利商店的地理位置非常好，停車也很方便，難怪生意那麼好。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā biànlì shāngdiàn de dìlǐ wèizhì fēicháng hǎo, tíngchē yě hěn fāngbiàn, nánguài shēngyì nàme hǎo.
examples.english: That convenience store's geographical location is excellent, and parking is also very convenient; no wonder business is so good.

examples.chinese: 那場強烈地震發生以後，許多國家的專業人員都來救災，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng qiángliè dìzhèn fāshēng yǐhòu, xǔduō guójiā de zhuānyè rényuán dōu lái jiùzāi, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: After that strong earthquake occurred, professionals from many countries came to provide disaster relief, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 那個小孩在這場大地震中失去了親人，實在太可憐了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái zài zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn zhōng shīqù le qīnrén, shízài tài kělián le.
examples.english: That child lost his family in this big earthquake; it's really too pitiful.

examples.chinese: 那家店正在推銷巧克力口味的小籠包，我們要不要去嘗試一下？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn zhèngzài tuīxiāo qiǎokèlì kǒuwèi de xiǎolóngbāo, wǒmen yào bù yào qù chángshì yīxià?
examples.english: That shop is promoting chocolate-flavored soup dumplings; shall we go try them?

examples.chinese: 太太：我今天很累，不想做飯。 先生：那就叫披薩好了。又快又不麻煩。
examples.pinyin: Tàitai: Wǒ jīntiān hěn lèi, bù xiǎng zuòfàn. Xiānsheng: Nà jiù jiào pīsà hǎo le. Yòu kuài yòu bù máfan.
examples.english: Wife: I'm very tired today, I don't want to cook. Husband: Then let's just order pizza. It's quick and not troublesome.

examples.chinese: 那個工人使用工廠的機器時，不小心發生了意外，流了很多血。
examples.pinyin: Nàge gōngrén shǐyòng gōngchǎng de jīqì shí, bù xiǎoxīn fāshēng le yìwài, liú le hěn duō xiě.
examples.english: When that worker was using the factory machine, an accident happened accidentally, and he bled a lot.

examples.chinese: 既然你不想衝浪，那就坐在海灘上曬曬太陽吧！
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ bù xiǎng chōnglàng, nà jiù zuò zài hǎitān shàng shài shài tàiyáng ba!
examples.english: Since you don't want to surf, then just sit on the beach and soak up some sun!

examples.chinese: 既然你那麼喜歡張小姐，就應該主動一點，約她去看電影、吃個飯什麼的。
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ nàme xǐhuān Zhāng xiǎojiě, jiù yīnggāi zhǔdòng yīdiǎn, yuē tā qù kàn diànyǐng, chī ge fàn shénme de.
examples.english: Since you like Miss Zhang so much, you should take the initiative a bit more—ask her out to a movie, a meal, or something.

examples.chinese: 那家動物餐廳的空間很大，可以讓客人的小動物自由自在地活動。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā dòngwù cāntīng de kōngjiān hěn dà, kěyǐ ràng kèrén de xiǎo dòngwù zìyóuzìzài de huódòng.
examples.english: That animal restaurant has a lot of space, allowing guests' small pets to move around freely and fancy-free.

examples.chinese: 有一些父母不讓孩子去夜店，主要是因為聽說那裡有人吸毒，也買得到毒品。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē fùmǔ bù ràng háizi qù yèdiàn, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi tīngshuō nàlǐ yǒu rén xīdú, yě mǎi de dào dúpǐn.
examples.english: Some parents don't let their children go to nightclubs, mainly because they've heard that people take drugs there and that drugs can be bought there.

examples.chinese: 那家民宿的地點實在太偏僻了，除了路不好走，附近也沒人住，想找個人問路都難。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā mínsù de dìdiǎn shízài tài piānpì le, chúle lù bù hǎo zǒu, fùjìn yě méi rén zhù, xiǎng zhǎo ge rén wèn lù dōu nán.
examples.english: That guesthouse's location is really too remote. Besides the road being hard to travel, there's no one living nearby either; it's hard even to find someone to ask for directions.

examples.chinese: 我記得第一次出國讀書時，因為不習慣和家人分開，常常半夜哭著打電話回家。那對情侶因為不了解而在一起，沒想到最後因為了解而分開。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde dì yī cì chūguó dúshū shí, yīnwèi bù xíguàn hé jiārén fēnkāi, chángcháng bànyè kūzhe dǎ diànhuà huí jiā. Nà duì qínglǚ yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér zài yīqǐ, méi xiǎngdào zuìhòu yīnwèi liǎojiě ér fēnkāi.
examples.english: I remember when I first went abroad to study, because I wasn't used to being separated from my family, I often cried on the phone at midnight. That couple got together because they didn't understand each other, but unexpectedly in the end they separated because they understood each other.

examples.chinese: 王小姐失戀後，花了三年時間才把那個男的忘掉。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiǎojiě shīliàn hòu, huā le sān nián shíjiān cái bǎ nàge nán de wàngdiào.
examples.english: After Ms. Wang was crossed in love, it took her three years to forget that man.

examples.chinese: 臺北美術館最近舉辦了很有名的畫展，吸引了很多民眾去欣賞那些畫。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi Měishùguǎn zuìjìn jǔbàn le hěn yǒumíng de huàzhǎn, xīyǐn le hěn duō mínzhòng qù xīnshǎng nàxiē huà.
examples.english: The Taipei Fine Arts Museum recently held a very famous painting exhibition, attracting many people to go appreciate those paintings.

examples.chinese: 今天藝術系的學生要在學校的禮堂，演出跟十二生肖有關的故事。 那名演員很厲害，在那部電影裡一個人演出三個角色。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān yìshù xì de xuéshēng yào zài xuéxiào de lǐtáng, yǎnchū gēn shí'èr shēngxiào yǒuguān de gùshì. Nà míng yǎnyuán hěn lìhài, zài nà bù diànyǐng lǐ yīgè rén yǎnchū sān gè juésè.
examples.english: Today the art department students are going to perform a story related to the twelve zodiac signs in the school auditorium. That actor is very impressive; in that movie, he performed three roles by himself.

examples.chinese: 那個明星對穿著很講究，總是花很多時間，研究什麼上衣配什麼長褲才好看。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng duì chuānzhuó hěn jiǎngjiū, zǒngshì huā hěn duō shíjiān, yánjiū shénme shàngyī pèi shénme chángkù cái hǎokàn.
examples.english: That star is very particular about apparel, always spending a lot of time researching what top goes with what pants to look good.

examples.chinese: 像衝浪、滑雪那樣的戶外活動，又刺激又好玩，不用說，絕對能吸引青少年。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng chōnglàng, huáxuě nàyàng de hùwài huódòng, yòu cìjī yòu hǎowán, bùyòng shuō, juéduì néng xīyǐn qīngshàonián.
examples.english: Outdoor activities like surfing and skiing are both exciting and fun; needless to say, they can definitely attract teenagers.

examples.chinese: 不管是誰，如果失去了親愛的家人，一定會很傷心、很痛苦，這是很自然的。那個女演員演戲的樣子很自然，一點也不誇張，難怪導演很欣賞她。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn shì shéi, rúguǒ shīqù le qīn'ài de jiārén, yīdìng huì hěn shāngxīn, hěn tòngkǔ, zhè shì hěn zìrán de. Nàge nǚ yǎnyuán yǎnxì de yàngzi hěn zìrán, yīdiǎn yě bù kuāzhāng, nánguài dǎoyǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
examples.english: No matter who it is, if they lose a beloved family member, they will certainly be very sad and in great pain; this is very natural. That actress's acting is very natural, not exaggerated at all; no wonder the director appreciates her.

examples.chinese: 去年生日爸爸送了我一輛自行車，從那天起，我就天天騎著它去上學。
examples.pinyin: Qùnián shēngrì bàba sòng le wǒ yī liàng zìxíngchē, cóng nà tiān qǐ, wǒ jiù tiāntiān qí zhe tā qù shàngxué.
examples.english: Last year on my birthday, Dad gave me a bicycle; from that day on, I have ridden it to school every day.

examples.chinese: 那位老太太年紀大了，沒辦法照顧他的狗，所以想幫狗找個新主人。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎotàitai niánjì dà le, méi bànfǎ zhàogù tā de gǒu, suǒyǐ xiǎng bāng gǒu zhǎo ge xīn zhǔrén.
examples.english: That old lady is advanced in age and has no way to take care of her dog, so she wants to find a new owner for the dog.

examples.chinese: 我們公司打算今年跟美國合作，生產名牌皮包。除夕那天，大家都忙著打掃、貼春聯，只有弟弟很不合作，什麼事都不做。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī dǎsuàn jīnnián gēn Měiguó hézuò, shēngchǎn míngpái píbāo. Chúxī nà tiān, dàjiā dōu mángzhe dǎsǎo, tiē chūnlián, zhǐyǒu dìdi hěn bù hézuò, shénme shì dōu bù zuò.
examples.english: Our company plans to cooperate with the US this year to produce brand-name leather bags. On New Year's Eve, everyone was busy cleaning and putting up spring couplets; only my younger brother was very uncooperative and didn't do anything.

examples.chinese: 這個紀念堂是為了紀念那些為國家犧牲生命的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìniàntáng shì wèile jìniàn nàxiē wèi guójiā xīshēng shēngmìng de jūnrén.
examples.english: This memorial hall is to commemorate those soldiers who sacrificed their lives for the country.

examples.chinese: 阿里山擁有豐富的森林資源和獨特的自然風景，每年都吸引不少遊客去那裡旅行。
examples.pinyin: Ālǐshān yǒngyǒu fēngfù de sēnlín zīyuán hé dútè de zìrán fēngjǐng, měi nián dōu xīyǐn bùshǎo yóukè qù nàlǐ lǚxíng.
examples.english: Alishan owns rich forest resources and unique natural scenery, attracting many tourists to travel there every year.

examples.chinese: 白小姐平時對穿著不怎麼講究，衣服穿來穿去總是那幾件。
examples.pinyin: Bái xiǎojiě píngshí duì chuānzhuó bù zěnme jiǎngjiu, yīfu chuān lái chuān qù zǒngshì nà jǐ jiàn.
examples.english: Miss Bai doesn't pay much attention to clothing in normal times; the clothes she wears are always just those few pieces.

examples.chinese: 那棟大樓發生火災時，還好安全人員很冷靜，才能帶著大家安全地離開。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng dàlóu fāshēng huǒzāi shí, hái hǎo ānquán rényuán hěn lěngjìng, cái néng dài zhe dàjiā ānquán de líkāi.
examples.english: When that building caught fire, fortunately the safety personnel were very calm, so they were able to lead everyone to leave safely.

examples.chinese: 有一些家長對現在的升學制度不滿，認為學校不應該逼孩子寫那麼多測驗題目。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng duì xiànzài de shēngxué zhìdù bùmǎn, rènwéi xuéxiào bù yīnggāi bī háizi xiě nàme duō cèyàn tímù.
examples.english: Some parents are dissatisfied with the current school advancement system and think that schools should not force children to write so many test questions.

examples.chinese: 那所非常有名的大學每年只錄取一千名新生，除了得成績夠好，還需要一點兒運氣才進得去。
examples.pinyin: Nà suǒ fēicháng yǒumíng de dàxué měi nián zhǐ lùqǔ yīqiān míng xīnshēng, chúle děi chéngjì gòu hǎo, hái xūyào yīdiǎnr yùnqi cái jìn de qù.
examples.english: That very famous university only admits one thousand new students each year; besides needing good enough grades, you also need a bit of luck to get in.

examples.chinese: 每個人一輩子都會遇到像沒考上大學、找不到工作那樣的挫折，但只要努力就有希望。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén yībèizi dōu huì yùdào xiàng méi kǎoshàng dàxué, zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò nàyàng de cuòzhé, dàn zhǐyào nǔlì jiù yǒu xīwàng.
examples.english: Everyone will encounter frustrations like not getting into university or not finding a job in their lifetime, but as long as you work hard, there is hope.

examples.chinese: 章先生念國小時，父親帶著他上山下海、到處旅遊，那是屬於他們的美好記憶。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng niàn guóxiǎo shí, fùqīn dàizhe tā shàngshān xiàhǎi, dàochù lǚyóu, nà shì shǔyú tāmen de měihǎo jìyì.
examples.english: When Mr. Zhang was in elementary school, his father took him up mountains and across seas, traveling everywhere; that is a beautiful memory belonging to them.

examples.chinese: 假如死了真的能上天堂，我想任何人都希望能夠在那裡跟最愛的人在一起。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú sǐle zhēnde néng shàng tiāntáng, wǒ xiǎng rènhé rén dōu xīwàng nénggòu zài nàlǐ gēn zuì ài de rén zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: If after death one could truly go to heaven, I think anyone would hope to be able to be there together with the person they love most.

examples.chinese: 那個老闆做生意不老實，一再跟客人保證商品沒問題，其實是騙人的。
examples.pinyin: Nàge lǎobǎn zuò shēngyì bù lǎoshí, yīzài gēn kèrén bǎozhèng shāngpǐn méi wèntí, qíshí shì piànrén de.
examples.english: That boss is not honest in doing business; he repeatedly assures customers that the products have no problems, but actually it's a scam.

examples.chinese: 在那場車禍中，那個孩子失去了父母，家裡只剩下他一個人，大家都很同情他。
examples.pinyin: Zài nà chǎng chēhuò zhōng, nàge háizi shīqù le fùmǔ, jiālǐ zhǐ shèng xià tā yī ge rén, dàjiā dōu hěn tóngqíng tā.
examples.english: In that car accident, that child lost his parents, and he was the only one left in the family; everyone sympathized with him.

examples.chinese: 那個網路商店經常賣假貨，你可別上當。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wǎnglù shāngdiàn jīngcháng mài jiǎhuò, nǐ kě bié shàngdàng.
examples.english: That online store often sells fake goods; you'd better not be tricked.

examples.chinese: 那個人喝了酒還開車，結果造成嚴重的車禍，害兩個人不幸死了，真可惡！
examples.pinyin: Nàge rén hē le jiǔ hái kāichē, jiéguǒ zàochéng yánzhòng de chēhuò, hài liǎng ge rén bùxìng sǐ le, zhēn kěwù!
examples.english: That person drank alcohol and still drove, resulting in a serious car accident that caused two people to die tragically; how detestable!

examples.chinese: 小時候爺爺常陪我做功課、教我打球和釣魚，現在回想起那段時間，感覺真幸福。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou yéye cháng péi wǒ zuò gōngkè, jiāo wǒ dǎqiú hé diàoyú, xiànzài huíxiǎng qǐ nà duàn shíjiān, gǎnjué zhēn xìngfú.
examples.english: When I was little, my grandfather often accompanied me to do homework and taught me to play ball and fish; now when I recall that time, I feel truly happy.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠自從改善了設備以後，生產速度就一天比一天快了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng zìcóng gǎishàn le shèbèi yǐhòu, shēngchǎn sùdù jiù yī tiān bǐ yī tiān kuài le.
examples.english: Ever since that factory improved its equipment, its production speed has become faster day by day.

examples.chinese: 那對雙胞胎長得很像，個性卻很不同，哥哥很大方，弟弟很害羞。
examples.pinyin: Nà duì shuāngbāotāi zhǎng de hěn xiàng, gèxìng què hěn bùtóng, gēge hěn dàfāng, dìdi hěn hàixiū.
examples.english: That pair of twins look very much alike, but their personalities are very different: the older brother is very outgoing, and the younger brother is very shy.

examples.chinese: 麗麗的老公在她生日那天，送了她九十九朵玫瑰花，好浪漫啊！
examples.pinyin: Lìlì de lǎogōng zài tā shēngrì nà tiān, sòng le tā jiǔshíjiǔ duǒ méiguīhuā, hǎo làngmàn a!
examples.english: Lili's husband gave her ninety-nine roses on her birthday; how romantic!

examples.chinese: 我知道那輛德國汽車很貴，至於到底多貴，我就不清楚了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào nà liàng Déguó qìchē hěn guì, zhìyú dàodǐ duō guì, wǒ jiù bù qīngchu le.
examples.english: I know that German car is very expensive; as to exactly how expensive, I'm not clear.

examples.chinese: 那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin: Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá. Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english: That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather. Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese: 那個店員的工作態度很隨便，常弄錯商品的價格，還找錯錢， 真是太誇張了！
examples.pinyin: Nàge diànyuán de gōngzuò tàidù hěn suíbiàn, cháng nòngcuò shāngpǐn de jiàgé, hái zhǎo cuò qián, zhēn shì tài kuāzhāng le!
examples.english: That clerk's work attitude is very careless; he often gets the product prices wrong and also gives the wrong change—that's really too outrageous!

examples.chinese: 不少人批評那家健身中心教練的教學品質很差，以後絕對不會再去了。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo rén pīpíng nà jiā jiànshēn zhōngxīn jiàoliàn de jiàoxué pǐnzhí hěn chà, yǐhòu juéduì bú huì zài qù le.
examples.english: Many people criticize that fitness center's coaches' teaching quality as very poor; they will absolutely not go there again.

examples.chinese: 結婚之前，那對情侶認真規劃了未來的生活，沒想到結婚一個月之後就離婚了。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn zhīqián, nà duì qínglǚ rènzhēn guīhuà le wèilái de shēnghuó, méi xiǎngdào jiéhūn yí ge yuè zhīhòu jiù líhūn le.
examples.english: Before getting married, that couple carefully planned their future life; unexpectedly, they divorced just one month after getting married.

examples.chinese: 那個店員只顧著玩手機，客人來了都不知道。
examples.pinyin: Nàge diànyuán zhǐ gùzhe wán shǒujī, kèrén lái le dōu bù zhīdào.
examples.english: That clerk only cared about playing on his phone; he didn't even notice when customers came.

examples.chinese: 那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi. Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.
examples.english: The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically. This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police.

examples.chinese: 公園附近的停車場還很空，你可以把車停到那裡去。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán fùjìn de tíngchēchǎng hái hěn kōng, nǐ kěyǐ bǎ chē tíng dào nàlǐ qù.
examples.english: The parking lot near the park is still very empty; you can park your car there.

examples.chinese: 那個外國人第一次來臺灣就碰上了大地震，讓他非常難忘。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wàiguó rén dì yī cì lái Táiwān jiù pèng shàng le dà dìzhèn, ràng tā fēicháng nánwàng.
examples.english: That foreigner encountered a major earthquake on his first visit to Taiwan, which made it very unforgettable for him.

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: 在國外工作的那幾年，他學會了什麼問題都自己解決，不依靠別人。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài gōngzuò de nà jǐ nián, tā xuéhuì le shénme wèntí dōu zìjǐ jiějué, bù yīkào biérén.
examples.english: In those few years working abroad, he learned to solve every problem himself, not relying on others.

examples.chinese: 那個美國人每天看臺灣的連續劇，一方面學習中文，一方面了解臺灣的生活文化。
examples.pinyin: Nàge Měiguórén měitiān kàn Táiwān de liánxùjù, yìfāngmiàn xuéxí Zhōngwén, yìfāngmiàn liǎojiě Táiwān de shēnghuó wénhuà.
examples.english: That American watches Taiwanese TV series every day: on one hand to learn Chinese, on the other hand to understand Taiwanese life and culture.

examples.chinese: 溫小姐在白色情人節那天，送給情人一盒巧克力。
examples.pinyin: Wēn xiǎojiě zài Báisè Qíngrén Jié nà tiān, sòng gěi qíngrén yì hé qiǎokèlì.
examples.english: On White Day, Miss Wen gave her lover a box of chocolates.

examples.chinese: 站在老闆背後的那個人已經通過了面試，明天就要來上班了。「每個成功男人的背後，都有一個偉大的女人。」你覺得這句話有道理嗎？
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhàn zài lǎobǎn bèihòu de nàge rén yǐjīng tōngguò le miànshì, míngtiān jiù yào lái shàngbān le. 2. Měi ge chénggōng nánrén de bèihòu, dōu yǒu yí ge wěidà de nǚrén. Nǐ juéde zhè jù huà yǒu dàolǐ ma?
examples.english: 1. The person standing behind the boss has already passed the interview and will come to work tomorrow. 2. Behind every successful man, there is a great woman. Do you think this saying makes sense?

examples.chinese: 客人看了那件洋裝一眼就走了，應該不喜歡吧。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén kàn le nà jiàn yángzhuāng yì yǎn jiù zǒu le, yīnggāi bù xǐhuān ba.
examples.english: The customer took one glance at that dress and then left; she probably doesn't like it.

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都要回到父母身邊，全家聚在一起吃年夜飯。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài Chúxī nà tiān, dōu yào huídào fùmǔ shēnbiān, quánjiā jù zài yìqǐ chī niányèfàn.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people all return to their parents' side, and the whole family gathers together to eat the New Year's Eve dinner.

examples.chinese: 外國人在臺灣生活期間，如果遇到任何問題，都可以打0800-024111，請求協助。那個壞人殺了人，他知道自己錯了，到教堂去請求上帝原諒。
examples.pinyin: 1. Wàiguórén zài Táiwān shēnghuó qījiān, rúguǒ yùdào rènhé wèntí, dōu kěyǐ dǎ 0800-024111, qǐngqiú xiézhù. 2. Nàge huàirén shā le rén, tā zhīdào zìjǐ cuò le, dào jiàotáng qù qǐngqiú Shàngdì yuánliàng.
examples.english: 1. During their time living in Taiwan, if foreigners encounter any problems, they can call 0800-024111 to request assistance. 2. That bad person killed someone; he knew he was wrong and went to church to beg God for forgiveness.

examples.chinese: 那部電影沒有結局，是導演要留給觀眾想像的空間。
examples.pinyin: Nà bù diànyǐng méiyǒu jiéjú, shì dǎoyǎn yào liú gěi guānzhòng xiǎngxiàng de kōngjiān.
examples.english: That movie has no ending; it is that the director wanted to leave space for the audience's imagination.

examples.chinese: 在真實世界中沒有「龍」這種動物，那只是古人的想像。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhēnshí shìjiè zhōng méiyǒu “lóng” zhè zhǒng dòngwù, nà zhǐshì gǔrén de xiǎngxiàng.
examples.english: In the real world, there is no such animal as a "dragon"; that is only the imagination of ancient people.

examples.chinese: 如想通過那家企業的面試，就得先熟悉他們的產品特色與銷售方式。
examples.pinyin: Rú xiǎng tōngguò nà jiā qǐyè de miànshì, jiù děi xiān shúxī tāmen de chǎnpǐn tèsè yǔ xiāoshòu fāngshì.
examples.english: If you want to pass that company's interview, you must first be familiar with their product features and sales methods.

examples.chinese: 顏教授對漢語語法有很深入的研究，難怪他的語法課那麼受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Yán jiàoshòu duì Hànyǔ yǔfǎ yǒu hěn shēnrù de yánjiū, nánguài tā de yǔfǎ kè nàme shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Professor Yan has very profound research on Chinese grammar; no wonder his grammar class is so popular.

examples.chinese: 那位畫家的作品十分生動，畫裡的人物好像真的能從畫裡走出來一樣。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi huàjiā de zuòpǐn shífēn shēngdòng, huà lǐ de rénwù hǎoxiàng zhēn de néng cóng huà lǐ zǒu chūlái yīyàng.
examples.english: That painter's works are extremely vivid; the figures in the paintings seem as if they could really walk out of the paintings.

examples.chinese: 那棟公寓自從三年前的一場大火之後，就不適合居住了。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng gōngyù zìcóng sān nián qián de yī chǎng dàhuǒ zhīhòu, jiù bù shìhé jūzhù le.
examples.english: Since a big fire three years ago, that apartment building has not been suitable for residing in.

examples.chinese: 王教授有一本古書，那本書已經有幾百年的歷史了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu yǒu yī běn gǔ shū, nà běn shū yǐjīng yǒu jǐ bǎi nián de lìshǐ le.
examples.english: Professor Wang has an old book; that book already has several hundred years of history.

examples.chinese: 歷史系的李教授最近經常接受記者的訪問，因此變得很有名。那名記者為了訪問總統外交、貿易等方面的問題，閱讀了許多相關的資料。
examples.pinyin: Lìshǐ xì de Lǐ jiàoshòu zuìjìn jīngcháng jiēshòu jìzhě de fǎngwèn, yīncǐ biàn de hěn yǒumíng. Nà míng jìzhě wèile fǎngwèn zǒngtǒng wàijiāo, màoyì děng fāngmiàn de wèntí, yuèdú le xǔduō xiāngguān de zīliào.
examples.english: Professor Li from the History Department has recently often been interviewed by reporters, and therefore has become very famous. That reporter, in order to interview the president about questions on diplomacy, trade, and other aspects, read a lot of related materials.

examples.chinese: 那個小偷趁著觀眾看表演的時候偷東西，結果當場就被安全人員抓了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎotōu chènzhe guānzhòng kàn biǎoyǎn de shíhou tōu dōngxi, jiéguǒ dāngchǎng jiù bèi ānquán rényuán zhuā le.
examples.english: That thief took advantage of the audience watching the performance to steal things, and as a result, he was caught on the spot by security personnel.

examples.chinese: 由於每個人看事情的角度不同，所以得溝通才能避免誤會。那個模特兒個子高、長得美，從什麼角度拍都漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú měi gè rén kàn shìqíng de jiǎodù bùtóng, suǒyǐ děi gōutōng cái néng bìmiǎn wùhuì. Nàge mótè'ér gèzi gāo, zhǎng de měi, cóng shénme jiǎodù pāi dōu piàoliang.
examples.english: Because each person's point of view on things is different, communication is necessary to avoid misunderstandings. That model is tall and beautiful; from whatever angle you photograph her, she looks pretty.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳人太多，我們去那家餐廳，好嗎？他們的牛肉麵很好吃，也很便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng rén tài duō. Wǒmen qù nà jiā cāntīng, hǎo ma? Tāmen de niúròu miàn hěn hǎochī, yě hěn piányi.
examples.english: There are too many people in this restaurant. How about that restaurant? They have delicious beef noodles, and it is also cheap.

examples.chinese: 我知道一家很不錯的咖啡廳，那裡的冰淇淋很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào yì jiā hěn búcuò de kāfēitīng, nàlǐ de bīngqílín hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: I know a nice café. They serve delicious ice cream.

examples.chinese: 那不是我的，是哥哥的。我的錢包不在客廳裡。
examples.pinyin: Nà bú shì wǒ de, shì gēge de. Wǒ de qiánbāo bú zài kètīng lǐ.
examples.english: It is not mine. It is my elder brother’s. Mine is not in the living room.

examples.chinese: 我們下午四點要到天美飯店，她在那裡等我們。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ sì diǎn yào dào Tiānměi Fàndiàn, tā zài nàli děng wǒmen.
examples.english: We have to arrive at Tianmei Hotel at 4 in the afternoon. She will wait for us there.

examples.chinese: 聽說那家飯店不遠，我想我們可以從學校走路去。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà jiā fàndiàn bù yuǎn, wǒ xiǎng wǒmen kěyǐ cóng xuéxiào zǒulù qù.
examples.english: I heard that the hotel is not far; I think we can go there from the school on foot.

examples.chinese: 可是我覺得那裡有點兒遠，走路去太累了。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ juéde nàlǐ yǒudiǎnr yuǎn, zǒulù qù tài lèi le.
examples.english: But I think it’s a bit far. It’s too tiring to get there on foot.

examples.chinese: 電梯在那裡！我們現在去買。
examples.pinyin: Diàntī zài nàlǐ! Wǒmen xiànzài qù mǎi.
examples.english: There is the elevator! Let’s go get them now.

examples.chinese: 那麼我們現在去找他。
examples.pinyin: Nàme wǒmen xiànzài qù zhǎo tā.
examples.english: Let’s go ask him now.

examples.chinese: 太好了！在那裡看書很舒服。我們每天都能用那間教室嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Zài nàlǐ kànshū hěn shūfu. Wǒmen měi tiān dōu néng yòng nà jiān jiàoshì ma?
examples.english: That’s awesome! Studying there is very comfortable. Can we use it every day?

examples.chinese: 他發燒了？那他應該去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Tā fāshāo le? Nà tā yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: He has a fever? He should see a doctor then.

examples.chinese: 那我這個週末一定要去看看。
examples.pinyin: Nà wǒ zhè ge zhōumò yídìng yào qù kànkan.
examples.english: Well then, I must see it this weekend.

items.wordHook: a 刀(knife) rests beside 二(two) marks on the 阝(place) wall → pointing at 那(that).

examples.chinese: 這棟房子不大，可是很貴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng fángzi bú dà, kěshì hěn guì.
examples.english: This is not a big house, but very expensive.

examples.chinese: 這棟房子不大，可是很貴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng fángzi bú dà, kěshì hěn guì.
examples.english: This is not a big house, but very expensive.

examples.chinese: 這個新房子沒有很多家具。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xīn fángzi méiyǒu hěn duō jiājù.
examples.english: There is not much furniture in this new house.

examples.chinese: 我的貓在房子外面曬太陽。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de māo zài fángzi wàimiàn shài tàiyáng.
examples.english: My cat is basking in the sun outside the house.

examples.chinese: 我的貓在房子外面曬太陽。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de māo zài fángzi wàimiàn shài tàiyáng.
examples.english: My cat is basking in the sun outside the house.

examples.chinese: 我往右看，看到了一間很漂亮的房子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wǎng yòu kàn, kàndào le yì jiān hěn piàoliang de fángzi.
examples.english: I looked to the right and saw a very beautiful house.

examples.chinese: 黑板上畫著一條河、一個湖，學生們還想畫一些山和房子。
examples.pinyin: Hēibǎn shàng huàzhe yī tiáo hé, yī gè hú, xuéshēngmen hái xiǎng huà yīxiē shān hé fángzi.
examples.english: On the blackboard, a river and a lake are drawn; the students also want to draw some mountains and houses.

examples.chinese: 美美最大的夢想是，將來能有一棟又漂亮又舒服的大房子。
examples.pinyin: Měiměi zuìdà de mèngxiǎng shì, jiānglái néng yǒu yī dòng yòu piàoliang yòu shūfu de dà fángzi.
examples.english: Meimei's biggest dream is that in the future she can have a big house that is both beautiful and comfortable.

examples.chinese: 我住的房子不大，也沒有很多錢，可是家人都很愛我， 讓我覺得很幸福、很滿足。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de fángzi bù dà, yě méiyǒu hěn duō qián, kěshì jiārén dōu hěn ài wǒ, ràng wǒ juéde hěn xìngfú, hěn mǎnzú.
examples.english: The house I live in isn't big, and I don't have a lot of money, but my family all love me, which makes me feel very happy and satisfied.

examples.chinese: 臺灣一般舊公寓的房子大約三十多坪，有客廳、廚房、一間浴室和三間臥房。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yìbān jiù gōngyù de fángzi dàyuē sānshí duō píng, yǒu kètīng, chúfáng, yì jiān yùshì hé sān jiān wòfáng.
examples.english: A typical old apartment in Taiwan is about thirty-something ping, with a living room, a kitchen, one bathroom, and three bedrooms.

examples.chinese: 媽媽對哥哥說，以他現在剛上班的情況，不能急著買房子，得等錢存夠了再買。
examples.pinyin: Māma duì gēge shuō, yǐ tā xiànzài gāng shàngbān de qíngkuàng, bùnéng jízhe mǎi fángzi, děi děng qián cún gòu le zài mǎi.
examples.english: Mom said to older brother, "Given your current situation of just starting work, you can't rush to buy a house; you have to wait until you've saved enough money before buying."

examples.chinese: 東部山區一連下了好幾天的大雨，有些房子倒了，公路也塌了，造成不少意外。
examples.pinyin: Dōngbù shānqū yíliàn xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, yǒuxiē fángzi dǎo le, gōnglù yě tā le, zàochéng bùshǎo yìwài.
examples.english: In the eastern mountain area, it rained heavily for several days in a row; some houses collapsed, and the highway also collapsed, causing many accidents.

examples.chinese: 地震後救災人員把握分分秒秒，努力把被困在房子底下的民眾救出來。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn hòu jiùzāi rényuán bǎwò fēnfēnmiǎomiǎo, nǔlì bǎ bèi kùn zài fángzi dǐxia de mínzhòng jiù chūlái.
examples.english: After the earthquake, the rescue workers seized every minute and every second, striving to rescue the people trapped under the houses.

examples.chinese: 管先生這段時間忙著布置新房子，希望給老婆一個又舒適又溫暖的家。
examples.pinyin: Guǎn xiānshēng zhè duàn shíjiān mángzhe bùzhì xīn fángzi, xīwàng gěi lǎopó yí ge yòu shūshì yòu wēnnuǎn de jiā.
examples.english: Mr. Guan has been busy decorating his new house during this time, hoping to give his wife a comfortable and warm home.

examples.chinese: 小年的夢想就是蓋一棟土地面積六十坪、三層樓高的房子，讓全家人都住在一起。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎonián de mèngxiǎng jiùshì gài yí dòng tǔdì miànjī liùshí píng, sān céng lóu gāo de fángzi, ràng quánjiā rén dōu zhù zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: Xiao Nian's dream is to build a three-story house with a land area of sixty ping, so that the whole family can live together.

items.wordHook: 房(house) + 子(noun suffix) → a little house: 房子(house; building).

examples.chinese: 從這裡往山上走，你就會看到很多牛。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ wǎng shān shàng zǒu, nǐ jiù huì kàndào hěn duō niú.
examples.english: If you walk up the mountain from here, you will see many cows.

examples.chinese: A:你想點什麼？ B:我想點一碗牛肉麵。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiǎng diǎn shénme? B: Wǒ xiǎng diǎn yì wǎn niúròu miàn.
examples.english: A: What would you like to order? B: I want to order a bowl of beef noodles.

examples.chinese: 你要果汁還是牛奶？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào guǒzhī háishì niúnǎi?
examples.english: Do you want juice or milk?

examples.chinese: A：你想點什麼？ B：我想點一碗牛肉麵。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiǎng diǎn shénme? B: Wǒ xiǎng diǎn yì wǎn niúròu miàn.
examples.english: A: What would you like to order? B: I want to order a bowl of beef noodles.

examples.chinese: 小姐，我們要點兩碗牛肉麵和兩杯茶。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎojiě, wǒmen yào diǎn liǎng wǎn niúròu miàn hé liǎng bēi chá.
examples.english: Miss, we would like to order two bowls of beef noodles and two cups of tea.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳人太多，我們去那家餐廳，好嗎？他們的牛肉麵很好吃，也很便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng rén tài duō. Wǒmen qù nà jiā cāntīng, hǎo ma? Tāmen de niúròu miàn hěn hǎochī, yě hěn piányi.
examples.english: There are too many people in this restaurant. How about that restaurant? They have delicious beef noodles, and it is also cheap.

examples.chinese: 太好了！我最愛吃牛肉麵。他們也賣飲料嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ zuì ài chī niúròu miàn. Tāmen yě mài yǐnliào ma?
examples.english: That is awesome! Beef noodles is my favorite. Do they sell drinks as well?

examples.chinese: 上次我們吃牛肉麵，這次也吃牛肉麵，下次吃別的吧。
examples.pinyin: Shàng cì wǒmen chī niúròumiàn, zhè cì yě chī niúròumiàn, xià cì chī bié de ba.
examples.english: Last time we ate beef noodles, this time we're also eating beef noodles; next time let's eat something else.

examples.chinese: 哥哥洗澡以後都先喝一瓶牛奶再睡覺。
examples.pinyin: Gēge xǐzǎo yǐhòu dōu xiān hē yì píng niúnǎi zài shuìjiào.
examples.english: After my older brother takes a shower, he always first drinks a bottle of milk and then goes to sleep.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳最辣的牛肉麵， 小程挑戰過好幾次，可惜都沒吃完。寫劇本對我來說是個很大的挑戰，但是也能得到不少收穫，所以我願意試試。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng zuì là de niúròumiàn, Xiǎo Chéng tiǎozhàn guò hǎo jǐ cì, kěxī dōu méi chī wán. Xiě jùběn duì wǒ lái shuō shì ge hěn dà de tiǎozhàn, dànshì yě néng dédào bùshǎo shōuhuò, suǒyǐ wǒ yuànyì shìshi.
examples.english: Xiao Cheng has challenged the spiciest beef noodles at this restaurant several times, but unfortunately he never finished them. Writing scripts is a big challenge for me, but I can also gain a lot from it, so I am willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: 顏先生對吃、喝都很講究，吃牛排時應該喝什麼酒，他也很有研究。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiānsheng duì chī, hē dōu hěn jiǎngjiū, chī niúpái shí yīnggāi hē shénme jiǔ, tā yě hěn yǒu yánjiū.
examples.english: Mr. Yan is very particular about eating and drinking; he has also studied what wine should be drunk when eating steak.

examples.chinese: 小何穿著綠色牛仔褲、紅襯衫，再戴上藍色的帽子，我覺得這些顏色配在一起很醜。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hé chuānzhe lǜsè niúzǎikù, hóng chènshān, zài dài shàng lánsè de màozi, wǒ juéde zhèxiē yánsè pèi zài yīqǐ hěn chǒu.
examples.english: Xiǎo Hé is wearing green jeans, a red shirt, and then puts on a blue hat; I think these colors paired together are very ugly.

examples.chinese: 有的人一喝牛奶就拉肚子，可能是因為身體吸收不料牛奶的營養。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu de rén yì hē niúnǎi jiù lādùzi, kěnéng shì yīnwèi shēntǐ xīshōu bù liǎo niúnǎi de yíngyǎng.
examples.english: Some people get diarrhea as soon as they drink milk; it may be because their body cannot absorb the nutrition in milk.

items.wordHook: A curved horn rises over a grazing snout on a sturdy farm 牛(cow).

examples.chinese: A:我覺得語言比數學有趣多了？ B:我同意你說的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ juéde yǔyán bǐ shùxué yǒuqù duō le? B: Wǒ tóngyì nǐ shuō de.
examples.english: A: I think languages are much more interesting than math? B: I agree with what you said.

examples.chinese: 有人說，男人的話題常跟政治有關，女人的話題不是名牌包、就是化妝品。你同意嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, nánrén de huàtí cháng gēn zhèngzhì yǒuguān, nǚrén de huàtí bùshì míngpái bāo, jiùshì huàzhuāngpǐn. Nǐ tóngyì ma?
examples.english: Some people say that men's topics are often related to politics, and women's topics are either designer bags or cosmetics. Do you agree?

examples.chinese: 在網路上，商品的交易雖然方便，但也應注意安全問題。許小姐知道社團網友想賣手機，就拿二手(second hand)筆電去交易，結果對方同意了。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǎnglù shàng, shāngpǐn de jiāoyì suīrán fāngbiàn, dàn yě yīng zhùyì ānquán wèntí. Xǔ xiǎojiě zhīdào shètuán wǎngyǒu xiǎng mài shǒujī, jiù ná èrshǒu bǐdiàn qù jiāoyì, jiéguǒ duìfāng tóngyì le.
examples.english: Online, although product transactions are convenient, you should also pay attention to safety issues. Miss Xu knew that a club netizen wanted to sell a cell phone, so she took a second-hand laptop to trade, and the other party agreed.

examples.chinese: 有人說好看的人像花瓶，好看卻沒有用，這句話我完全不同意。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō hǎokàn de rén xiàng huāpíng, hǎokàn què méiyǒu yòng, zhè jù huà wǒ wánquán bù tóngyì.
examples.english: Some people say that good-looking people are like flower vases—good-looking but useless; I completely disagree with this statement.

items.wordHook: 同(same) + 意(idea) → sharing the same idea: 同意 means to agree.

examples.chinese: 除夕那一天，要拜完祖先才能吃年夜飯。
examples.pinyin: Chúxī nà yī tiān, yào bài wán zǔxiān cái néng chī niányèfàn.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, you must finish worshipping the ancestors before you can eat the New Year's Eve dinner.

examples.chinese: 絕大部分的華人都很重視春節，所以回家團圓、互相拜年，他們認為都是該做的。
examples.pinyin: Jué dà bùfèn de Huárén dōu hěn zhòngshì Chūnjié, suǒyǐ huíjiā tuányuán, hùxiāng bàinián, tāmen rènwéi dōu shì gāi zuò de.
examples.english: The vast majority of Chinese people value the Spring Festival highly, so they believe that going home for family reunions and exchanging New Year greetings are things that should be done.

examples.chinese: 因為最近太多人感冒的關係，來上課的同學變少了，我們班不過十個人，就有五個人請假 。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi zuìjìn tài duō rén gǎnmào de guānxi, lái shàngkè de tóngxué biàn shǎo le, wǒmen bān búguò shí ge rén, jiù yǒu wǔ ge rén qǐngjià.
examples.english: Because too many people have caught colds recently, fewer classmates are coming to class; in our class of only ten people, five have asked for leave.

examples.chinese: 吉米來臺灣五年了，喜歡這裡的食物和人，不過還不能適應夏天的天氣。
examples.pinyin: Jímǐ lái Táiwān wǔ nián le, xǐhuān zhèlǐ de shíwù hé rén, bùguò hái bù néng shìyìng xiàtiān de tiānqì.
examples.english: Jimmy has been in Taiwan for five years and likes the food and people here, but he still can't adapt to the summer weather.

examples.chinese: 雖然工作很重要，不過身體健康更重要。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán gōngzuò hěn zhòngyào, búguò shēntǐ jiànkāng gèng zhòngyào.
examples.english: Although work is important, health is even more important.

examples.chinese: 雖然小馬的個子不高，不過籃球打得可好了。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán Xiǎo Mǎ de gèzi bù gāo, bùguò lánqiú dǎ de kě hǎo le.
examples.english: Although Xiao Ma's build is not tall, he plays basketball really well.

examples.chinese: 最近很多人感冒了，不過不必太擔心，只要戴上口罩、別去人多的地方就行了。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén gǎnmào le, bùguò bùbì tài dānxīn, zhǐyào dài shàng kǒuzhào, bié qù rén duō de dìfāng jiù xíng le.
examples.english: Many people have caught colds recently, but you don't need to worry too much; as long as you wear a mask and don't go to crowded places, it's all right.

examples.chinese: 小高總是在別人面前表現得很有禮貌，不過回到家就完全變了一個樣子。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎogāo zǒngshì zài biérén miànqián biǎoxiàn de hěn yǒu lǐmào, búguò huí dào jiā jiù wánquán biàn le yí ge yàngzi.
examples.english: Xiao Gao always behaves very politely in front of others, but when he gets home he completely changes into a different person.

examples.chinese: 臭豆腐是臺灣有名的小吃，不過味道很獨特，不是每個人都能接受。
examples.pinyin: Chòu dòufu shì Táiwān yǒumíng de xiǎochī, búguò wèidào hěn dútè, bú shì měi ge rén dōu néng jiēshòu.
examples.english: Stinky tofu is a famous snack in Taiwan, but its flavor is very unique; not everyone can accept it.

examples.chinese: 人人都渴望浪漫的愛情和幸福的家庭，不過自由自在的單身生活也是不錯的。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu kěwàng làngmàn de àiqíng hé xìngfú de jiātíng, búguò zìyóuzìzài de dānshēn shēnghuó yě shì búcuò de.
examples.english: Everyone longs for romantic love and a happy family, but a free and easy single life is also not bad.

examples.chinese: 人人都喜歡薪水高、離家近、輕鬆的工作，不過這往往只是一個夢。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu xǐhuan xīnshuǐ gāo, lí jiā jìn, qīngsōng de gōngzuò, búguò zhè wǎngwǎng zhǐshì yí ge mèng.
examples.english: Everyone likes a job with a high salary, close to home, and easy, but this is often just a dream.

examples.chinese: 我打工的餐廳一到週末就客滿，忙不過來的時候，連老闆的叔叔都得來幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎgōng de cāntīng yí dào zhōumò jiù kèmǎn, máng bú guòlái de shíhou, lián lǎobǎn de shūshu dōu děi lái bāngmáng.
examples.english: The restaurant where I work part-time is full every weekend; when they are too busy to manage, even the boss's uncle has to come help.

examples.chinese: 你忙不過來的時候就該找人幫忙，別讓自己累壞了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ máng bú guòlái de shíhou jiù gāi zhǎo rén bāngmáng, bié ràng zìjǐ lèihuài le.
examples.english: When you are too busy to manage, you should find someone to help; don't let yourself get exhausted.

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: 幸虧你來幫忙，要不然我一個人絕對忙不過來。幸虧我把資料都存在雲端，要不然找不到隨身碟，怎麼開會呢？
examples.pinyin: 1. Xìngkuī nǐ lái bāngmáng, yàobùrán wǒ yí ge rén juéduì máng bú guòlái. 2. Xìngkuī wǒ bǎ zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, yàobùrán zhǎo bú dào suíshēndié, zěnme kāihuì ne?
examples.english: 1. Thanks to your help, otherwise I definitely wouldn't be able to handle it alone. 2. Fortunately, I saved all the data in the cloud; otherwise, if I couldn't find the USB drive, how could we have the meeting?

examples.chinese: 儘管這次推銷新產品的活動辦得很順利，顧客的反應也很好，不過還是有需要改進的地方。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè cì tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de huódòng bàn de hěn shùnlì, gùkè de fǎnyìng yě hěn hǎo, bùguò háishì yǒu xūyào gǎijìn de dìfāng.
examples.english: Although this event to promote the new product went very smoothly and customers' reactions were also very good, there are still areas that need improvement.

examples.chinese: 我已經退休了，不過還時常跟幾位要好的同事通信。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng tuìxiū le, bùguò hái shícháng gēn jǐ wèi yàohǎo de tóngshì tōngxìn.
examples.english: I have already retired, but I still often correspond with a few close colleagues.

examples.chinese: 雖然我是臺灣人，不過臺灣有一些地方我可是從來都沒去過。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán wǒ shì Táiwān rén, bùguò Táiwān yǒu yīxiē dìfāng wǒ kěshì cónglái dōu méi qùguò.
examples.english: Although I am Taiwanese, there are indeed some places in Taiwan that I have never been to.

examples.chinese: 有一些口罩正面跟反面的差異很小，不過一般來說，正面的顏色較深，反面的顏色較淺。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē kǒuzhào zhèngmiàn gēn fǎnmiàn de chāyì hěn xiǎo, bùguò yībān lái shuō, zhèngmiàn de yánsè jiào shēn, fǎnmiàn de yánsè jiào qiǎn.
examples.english: For some masks, the difference between the front side and the reverse side is very small, but generally speaking, the front side is darker in color and the reverse side is lighter.

examples.chinese: 發展科技對國家來說很重要，不過也應該注意環保問題。
examples.pinyin: Fāzhǎn kējì duì guójiā lái shuō hěn zhòngyào, bùguò yě yīnggāi zhùyì huánbǎo wèntí.
examples.english: Developing technology is very important for a country, but attention should also be paid to environmental protection issues.

examples.chinese: 小李離婚後才知道失去老婆很痛苦，不過後悔也來不及了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ líhūn hòu cái zhīdào shīqù lǎopo hěn tòngkǔ, bùguò hòuhuǐ yě láibují le.
examples.english: Only after divorcing did Little Li realize that losing his wife is very painful, but it's too late to be regretful.

examples.chinese: 跟朋友飲酒是一件開心的事，不過飲酒過度卻可能傷害身體。
examples.pinyin: Gēn péngyǒu yǐn jiǔ shì yí jiàn kāixīn de shì, búguò yǐn jiǔ guòdù què kěnéng shānghài shēntǐ.
examples.english: Drinking alcohol with friends is a happy thing, but excessive drinking may harm your health.

examples.chinese: 我很怕熱，不過天氣太冷的時候，也不得不開暖氣。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn pà rè, bùguò tiānqì tài lěng de shíhou, yě bùdébù kāi nuǎnqì.
examples.english: I am very afraid of heat, but when the weather is too cold, I have no choice but to turn on the heater.

examples.chinese: 銀做的東西雖然漂亮，不過不好保養。
examples.pinyin: Yín zuò de dōngxi suīrán piàoliang, bùguò bù hǎo bǎoyǎng.
examples.english: Although things made of silver are beautiful, they are not easy to maintain.

examples.chinese: 我採花的時候被刺了一下，不過還好不太痛。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cǎi huā de shíhou bèi cì le yīxià, bùguò hái hǎo bù tài tòng.
examples.english: When I was picking flowers, I got pricked once, but fortunately it didn't hurt too much.

examples.chinese: 彩色照片看起來很真實，不過黑白照片給人的感覺也很特別。
examples.pinyin: Cǎisè zhàopiàn kàn qǐlái hěn zhēnshí, bùguò hēibái zhàopiàn gěi rén de gǎnjué yě hěn tèbié.
examples.english: Color photos look very realistic, but black-and-white photos also give people a very special feeling.

examples.chinese: 我對人體各部分的功能很有興趣，不過我沒想過當醫生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì réntǐ gè bùfèn de gōngnéng hěn yǒu xìngqù, bùguò wǒ méi xiǎngguò dāng yīshēng.
examples.english: I'm very interested in the functions of the various parts of the human body, but I've never thought about becoming a doctor.

examples.chinese: 小王追求祝小姐好幾年了，不過祝小姐一直只把她當好友。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng zhuīqiú Zhù xiǎojiě hǎo jǐ nián le, búguò Zhù xiǎojiě yìzhí zhǐ bǎ tā dāng hǎoyǒu.
examples.english: Xiao Wang has been pursuing Miss Zhu for several years, but Miss Zhu has always only regarded him as a good friend.

examples.chinese: 公司的工作須知訂得非常詳細，不過從來沒有員工仔細看完。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de gōngzuò xūzhī dìng de fēicháng xiángxì, bùguò cónglái méiyǒu yuángōng zǐxì kàn wán.
examples.english: The company's work guidelines are set out in great detail, but no employee has ever read them carefully all the way through.

examples.chinese: 他想成為網路作家，不過擔心將來的收入可能不穩定。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng chéngwéi wǎnglù zuòjiā, bùguò dānxīn jiānglái de shōurù kěnéng bù wěndìng.
examples.english: He wants to become an online writer, but worries that his future income may be unstable.

examples.chinese: 小張出車禍雖然賠了很多錢，不過好在人沒事。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng chū chēhuò suīrán péi le hěn duō qián, bùguò hǎozài rén méi shì.
examples.english: Although Xiao Zhang had a car accident and paid a lot of money, fortunately no one was hurt.

examples.chinese: 我想在床旁邊擺個書桌，不過空間不太夠，你可以幫我把床移到牆邊嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài chuáng pángbiān bǎi ge shūzhuō, búguò kōngjiān bú tài gòu, nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ bǎ chuáng yí dào qiáng biān ma?
examples.english: I want to put a desk next to the bed, but there isn't quite enough space. Could you help me move the bed to the wall?

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，有人說夏天開冷氣不如開除溼機，不過有專家表示，它們的功能無法互相取代。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, yǒu rén shuō xiàtiān kāi lěngqì bùrú kāi chúshījī, bùguò yǒu zhuānjiā biǎoshì, tāmen de gōngnéng wúfǎ hùxiāng qǔdài.
examples.english: In Taiwan, some people say that in summer, turning on the air conditioner is not as good as turning on a dehumidifier, but some experts say that their functions cannot replace each other.

examples.chinese: A:我太糊塗了，忘了把變更後的網路銀行密碼記下來。 B:這下子你得親自去銀行處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ tài hútu le, wàng le bǎ biàngēng hòu de wǎnglù yínháng mìmǎ jì xiàlái. B: Zhè xiàzi nǐ děi qīnzì qù yínháng chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: I was too careless and forgot to write down the changed internet banking password. B: Now you'll have to go to the bank in person to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 看電影時，如果要暫時離開座位，記得把重要物品帶在身上。
examples.pinyin: Kàn diànyǐng shí, rúguǒ yào zhànshí líkāi zuòwèi, jìde bǎ zhòngyào wùpǐn dài zài shēnshang.
examples.english: When watching a movie, if you need to temporarily leave your seat, remember to carry your important belongings with you.

examples.chinese: 危險物品必須放在小朋友伸手拿不到的地方。
examples.pinyin: Wēixiǎn wùpǐn bìxū fàng zài xiǎopéngyǒu shēnshǒu ná bù dào de dìfāng.
examples.english: Dangerous items must be placed in a place where children cannot reach out and get them.

examples.chinese: 當你急著需要某個物品時，不管划不划算，都非買不可。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ jízhe xūyào mǒu gè wùpǐn shí, bùguǎn huá bù huásuàn, dōu fēi mǎi bùkě.
examples.english: When you urgently need a certain item, regardless of whether it is cost-effective or not, you simply must buy it.

examples.chinese: 這輛卡車有十二個輪子，大約能載二十五噸的物品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng kǎchē yǒu shí'èr ge lúnzi, dàyuē néng zài èrshíwǔ dūn de wùpǐn.
examples.english: This truck has twelve wheels and can carry about twenty-five tons of goods.

examples.chinese: 有些國家機場對攜帶物品的規定很嚴，出國前最好了解清楚。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā jīchǎng duì xiédài wùpǐn de guīdìng hěn yán, chūguó qián zuìhǎo liǎojiě qīngchu.
examples.english: Some countries' airports have very strict regulations on carried items; before going abroad, it's best to understand them clearly.

examples.chinese: 那家博物館平日展覽的物品很多，中多半與古代科技有關。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā bówùguǎn píngrì zhǎnlǎn de wùpǐn hěn duō, qízhōng duōbàn yǔ gǔdài kējì yǒu guān.
examples.english: That museum exhibits many items on weekdays, most of which are related to ancient technology.

examples.chinese: 根據本大樓的管理規定，私人物品不可堆在公共區域。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù běn dàlóu de guǎnlǐ guīdìng, sīrén wùpǐn bùkě duī zài gōnggòng qūyù.
examples.english: According to the management rules of this building, personal items may not be piled up in public areas.

examples.chinese: 她的物品上都有個小小的蝴蝶標誌，避免別人拿錯。
examples.pinyin: Tā de wùpǐn shàng dōu yǒu ge xiǎoxiǎo de húdié biāozhì, bìmiǎn biérén ná cuò.
examples.english: All her items have a small butterfly mark on them, to avoid others taking them by mistake.

items.wordHook: Combining 物(thing) and 品(article): 物品 means article, goods.

examples.chinese: 過年時什麼都漲，連搭計程車的時候，車費都漲價了。
examples.pinyin: Guònián shí shénme dōu zhǎng, lián dā jìchéngchē de shíhou, chēfèi dōu zhǎngjià le.
examples.english: During Chinese New Year everything goes up in price; even when taking a taxi, the fare has increased.

examples.chinese: 外面風大，最好穿件外套出門，免得感冒了。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn fēng dà, zuìhǎo chuān jiàn wàitào chūmén, miǎnde gǎnmào le.
examples.english: It's windy outside; it's best to put on a jacket before going out, so as not to catch a cold.

examples.chinese: 這次傳染病的病毒很厲害，出門得戴著口罩，免得被傳染。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chuánrǎnbìng de bìngdú hěn lìhài, chūmén děi dàizhe kǒuzhào, miǎnde bèi chuánrǎn.
examples.english: The virus of this infectious disease is very severe; when going out, you must wear a mask so as not to get infected.

examples.chinese: 帶孩子到餐廳用餐，得提醒他們別到處奔跑，免得跌倒。
examples.pinyin: Dài háizi dào cāntīng yòngcān, děi tíxǐng tāmen bié dàochù bēnpǎo, miǎnde diēdǎo.
examples.english: When taking children to a restaurant to eat, you must remind them not to run around, so they don't fall.

examples.chinese: 開車去喝喜酒的人碰到敬酒時最好拒絕，免得回家路上發生意外。
examples.pinyin: Kāichē qù hē xǐjiǔ de rén pèngdào jìngjiǔ shí zuìhǎo jùjué, miǎnde huíjiā lùshàng fāshēng yìwài.
examples.english: People who drive to drink wedding wine had best refuse when they encounter a toast, so as to avoid an accident on the way home.

examples.chinese: 老師提醒學生有疑問要馬上解決，免得越到後面越不了解。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī tíxǐng xuéshēng yǒu yíwèn yào mǎshàng jiějué, miǎnde yuè dào hòumiàn yuè bù liǎojiě.
examples.english: The teacher reminded the students that if they have any questions, they should resolve them immediately, lest the further they go, the less they understand.

examples.chinese: 賽跑前要先做點兒運動，免得受傷。
examples.pinyin: Sàipǎo qián yào xiān zuò diǎnr yùndòng, miǎnde shòushāng.
examples.english: Before racing, you should do some exercise first, so as to avoid getting hurt.

examples.chinese: 這次傳染病的病毒很厲害，出門得戴著口罩，免得被傳染。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chuánrǎnbìng de bìngdú hěn lìhài, chūmén děi dàizhe kǒuzhào, miǎnde bèi chuánrǎn.
examples.english: The virus of this infectious disease is very severe; when going out, you must wear a mask so as not to get infected.

examples.chinese: 水災過後應立刻打掃環境，才能降低傳染病流行的機會。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐzāi guòhòu yīng lìkè dǎsǎo huánjìng, cái néng jiàngdī chuánrǎnbìng liúxíng de jīhuì.
examples.english: After a flood, one should immediately clean up the environment; only then can the chance of infectious diseases spreading be reduced.

items.wordHook: Combining 以(according to) and 下(below): 以下 means below, under.
Combining 包(pack) and 含(hold in the mouth): 包含 means include.
Shouts from shouting mouths echo off the steep 厂(cliff) as the commander gives 嚴(strict) orders.
小(small) + 籠(steamer basket) + 包(bun) → small-basket buns: 小籠包 are soup dumplings.
At the 中(central) point, a 一(one) 貝(sea shell) rests → a 貴(expensive) price.
車(vehicle) + 子(noun suffix): a car → 子 just makes it a noun.
